obligate.description: Connect this app to your Obligate SSO gateway for centralized authentication and cross-app navigation. Register this app in Obligate first, then paste the API key here.
obligate.warning: When enabled, local authentication is disabled. Users must sign in through the Obligate gateway. If the gateway becomes unreachable, local authentication is automatically restored as a fallback.

inboundSecret.label: Inbound secret (optional)
inboundSecret.placeholder: Empty: the API key is expected
inboundSecret.fromEnv: Set by the OBLIGATE_INBOUND_SECRET environment variable.
inboundSecret.hint: Secret that Obligate must present when it calls this server (user sync, app info, dashboard stats), at least 16 characters. Leave empty to keep expecting the API key. Set it only once Obligate sends a separate secret: otherwise all of its calls are refused, and the deactivations and deletions of SSO users no longer reach this server.
inboundSecret.tooShort: The inbound secret must be at least 16 characters long.
inboundSecret.confirmMessage: From now on, Obligate calls to this server must present this secret instead of the API key. Obligate does not send a separate secret yet: until it is updated to send this one, all of its calls will be refused, including the deactivations and deletions of SSO users, which will then no longer reach this server.

obligate.splitRequired: A second administrator must approve changes to these settings, and an approval never keeps a secret: save the gateway address on its own first (a second administrator approves it), then the API key on its own (a code is asked).

settings.title: Phone validation
settings.originMissing: Not configured: enrolment is refused. Set APP_URL (or CLIENT_ORIGIN) or DEVICE_KEY_ORIGINS.
settings.enabledDesc: Phones registered in the Android app validate sensitive actions with the fingerprint instead of a code. Off: no fingerprint anywhere, keys are kept.
settings.loginDesc: Local accounts sign in to the app with their password and the fingerprint instead of a code.
settings.requireAttestationDesc: A phone must prove (Google key attestation) that its key lives in the secure hardware, on a locked, verified system. Turning this on revokes the phones accepted without it.
settings.strictSessionDesc: On a registered phone, a code alone is refused (password + code instead). Trusted IPs never apply on a registered phone, whatever this switch says.
settings.envDisabled: Emergency switch DEVICE_KEYS_DISABLED is set on the server: the feature is off whatever the switches below say.
settings.confirmRequireAttestation: Phones registered without a verified attestation will be revoked now. Continue?

sso.title: Obligate accounts
sso.switchOff: Off on this server (DEVICE_KEYS_SSO_ENABLED is not set): Obligate accounts validate with their code, as before.
sso.ssoOff: Obligate sign-in is disabled or not configured.
sso.announced: On: Obligate announces the required capabilities, Obligate accounts can register a phone.
sso.withdrawn: Closed: Obligate answers without the required capabilities (OAUTH_LOT_O_CAPABILITIES=false). Registered phones fall back to the code.
sso.unreachable: Obligate cannot be checked right now: phone validation is refused for Obligate accounts, and registered phones cannot validate until it answers. An Obligate older than 0.1.67 also shows here: turn DEVICE_KEYS_SSO_ENABLED off before rolling Obligate back.

reauth.hint: On this phone, validation is done with the fingerprint. To use a code instead, first confirm your identity with Obligate (valid 5 minutes), then run the action again.
reauth.ok: Identity confirmed with Obligate for 5 minutes: run the action again and enter your code.

reason.no_otp: Enable two-factor authentication in your Obligate account first: the confirmation needs your password and a code.
reason.identity: Another Obligate account was used. Confirm with the Obligate account you are signed in with here.
reason.stale_auth: Obligate did not ask for a new sign-in. Try again and enter your password and code at Obligate.
reason.unsupported: Confirmation with Obligate is not available on this server right now.
reason.verifier_unavailable: Obligate could not confirm your account right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.unreachable: Obligate cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.origin: Open Obliance at its public address to confirm with Obligate.
reason.expired: The confirmation took too long (over 10 minutes). Try again.
reason.signed_out: You were signed out meanwhile. Sign in again.
reason.state: The confirmation could not be matched to this session. Try again from this page.
reason.exchange: Obligate did not confirm the sign-in. Try again.
reason.not_sso: This account does not sign in with Obligate: confirmation with Obligate does not apply.
reason.misconfigured: Obligate is misconfigured on this server (it points to Obliance itself). Contact an administrator.
